Experrectum quidem esse per omnia, immor-
talis naturæ proprium est, moderatè verò dormire,

humanum. sed ultra dormire quàm decet conue-
niens potius mortuis est, quâ vivis plurimas, Chry-

Vlysses extra habitatum nobis orbem exerrans,
quasi in Oceani vicem vsus somno; & neque sur-
gentem neq; cadentem Solem videns.
Ruff. DAPHNON ÆGIRO. LVI.
Ficus tuæ in meum fundamentum radices extende-
runt, sub ditione tua amplius esse detrectantes. &
iurisdictione tua sublata mihi donant suos pro-

page.notes: Right edge strip (fragments such as "Ye", "ud", "tu", "lig") is the edge of the neighbouring page and was left out. Doubtful: running head "SIMOCATI" (scan reads "sIMOCATI"); "abunoin" (possibly "ab uno in", word space unclear); "Ruff." heading (possibly Greek, not certain); "quá" read as qua. Long s rendered as plain s throughout. "vivis" and "vsus" follow the u/v rule (printed viuis, vfus).
